tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: All private tours of Discover Leiden that can be booked in Leiden, the Netherlands. Returns per tour: id, title, description, duration, group size, starting price, departure point and booking page.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Full details of one tour: description, departure point, duration, group size, prices (incl. seasonal prices), regular start times, optional extras with their ids and prices, cancellation policy and contact details.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free start times of a tour per day. Tours can be booked far ahead (usually up to a year; the result says until when in bookable_until). Each call covers at most 31 days from date_from (default 14); date_from can be any date up to bookable_until, so call again for later periods. Times are local Leide

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Exact price for a group on a date (prices can depend on the season), including chosen extras and the VAT breakdown. Same calculation as the booking page.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Checks that the time is still free and returns a secure booking link with tour, date, time, guests and extras already filled in.
